last_checked_note: Scheduled 09:00 run on 22 November, checked at 09:05 IST. No fix added. The morning All India Weather Summary and Forecast Bulletin of the 22nd is now out, issued 08:26 IST and analysed on 05:30 IST, and it keeps the low pressure area over north Chhattisgarh & neighbourhood at 05:30 of today, with the associated cyclonic circulation extending to 4.5 km above mean sea level tilting south-westwards; it gives no latitude or longitude, so no position can be appended. IMD's cyclone bulletin series still ends at National Bulletin No. 42 (BOB/10/2026), 01:15 IST on 21 November, based on the 23:30 observation of the 20th, which declared itself the last update for Akvan, and the newest cyclone bulletin the IMD site still serves is the 20 November 2030 issue based on 17:30 IST, already recorded. The record stays at thirty-eight fixes, the last at 20.2N 84.9E at 17:30 on 20 November.

forecast.as: a cyclonic storm at the coast, weakening inland
forecast.note: IMD's corridor, north Andhra Pradesh and Yanam to south Odisha, the centre closest to Gopalpur. The crossing is now observed: near 19.1N 84.8E between 0730 and 0830 IST on 20 November, with 70-80 kmph gusting 90 kmph. The system weakened into a deep depression over south coastal Odisha at 1130 IST, at 19.6N 84.9E, and is expected to weaken further into a depression and then a well marked low over Odisha.
